breakdown.description: The local normal traction on the hypotenuse is replaced by a global vertical vector
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the traction as 't = p n' where n is the outward unit normal to the sloping boundary, and formulates the boundary integral as ∫Γt (p n)·v ds. This matches the ground truth's instruction to interpret the load in the local boundary-normal direction, and does not repeat the incomplete prompt's error of using a fixed Cartesian vector (0, +p).
